card.name: Botulinum toxin label text (Botox)
card.fires_on: Small linking words, spaces and word starts inside botulinum toxin (BOTOX, LETYBO) labels, just before the product name or a table or dose reference. It responds in cosmetic-injection label text, not to one fixed word.

modes.label: Linking words near toxin names
modes.description: A small word such as including, and, of or in right before or after a botulinum toxin product name.

card.plain: It lights up in Botox-type cosmetic injection labels and nudges the model toward words about beauty.
